answer: A new agent enters the market through a harbor: its first payouts sit in escrow for ten epochs, and they are released only if graders it has never transacted with confirm the work was real. Each extra identity has to wait out its own escrow and earn its own confirmations, so a farm of a thousand keys hits a reef of frozen capital instead of a shortcut. Fifty clones turning in the same sonnet with a few words changed get flagged as near-duplicates and lose that escrow.
